replies.text:
Fatlib try by fully disabling all user installed apps. Reboot. Don't enable the disabled apps until at least 24h passed.

Is the battery consumption identical to during the issue were present?

replies.author: Fatlib
replies.text:
Novaliss I did and now I've found out, what's the problem was. I was definately wrong to blame the OS cause I got the proof that it wasn't.

The cause for the whole problem was the Signal App which came from the official website via apk and was installed completely without G Play Store and G Apps. I dont need Signal on the Pixel Phone, therefore I deinstalled it.
